description: This file contains integration tests for the article deletion feature in a .NET (ASP.NET Core) project. It tests various scenarios such as deleting an article normally, deleting an article with tags, and deleting an article with associated comments.

classes.name: DeleteTests
classes.description: A test class containing integration tests for deleting articles, covering scenarios with and without tags and comments.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article
methods.description: Tests the deletion of a simple article without additional relations.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Tags
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an article that has associated tags.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an article that has associated comments.
